title: Posebook: How I Run Monday Night Figure Drawing
description: A one-minute story: running a weekly figure drawing session at Enoch's in New York, and how Posebook lets models manage their own schedule while it does the reminding.
meta: dblock/posebook · master @ 907458c · app screens from a local run with fictional data

scenes.title: Enoch's
steps: For over a year, I've run a Monday night figure drawing session at Enoch's, a coffee shop in New York.

scenes.title: By Hand
steps: Every Monday after the session, I'd text next week's model to re-confirm.
And all week, models wrote in to swap dates. All of it by hand.

scenes.title: Posebook
steps: So I built Posebook: models manage their own schedule, and it does the reminding.

scenes.title: Set It Up Once
steps: I set the session up once:

scenes.title: Models Book Themselves
steps: Models I've invited pick an open Monday and book it themselves.
They swap or cancel on their own, and confirm with one tap: I'll be there!

scenes.title: My Calendar
steps: My calendar shows who's posing each week, and who has confirmed.

scenes.title: Reminders and Google Calendar
steps: Posebook asks next week's model to confirm, and reminds them before the session.
And my Google Calendar is managed automatically.

scenes.title: Run It Yourself
steps: Posebook is open source. Run it for your drawing group.

scenes.title: Come Draw With Us
steps: And if you're in New York, come draw with us: Mondays at six-thirty, at Enoch's.
